title: The 2026 Global Yachting Compass: This Year's Must-Attend Boat Shows
description: Explore the must-attend 2026 yachting events—Monaco, Miami, Cannes and more—your curated guide to superyacht shows, launches, and VIP access.
html:
From the Turquoises of the Caribbean to the Cobblestones of the Côte d’Azur: Your Curated Guide to the Premier Yachting Events Defining the 2026 Season.

For the true yachting enthusiast, the calendar isn’t measured in months, but in latitudes. From the glittering docks of Monaco to the vibrant energy of our home base in Miami, 2026 promises to be a landmark year for naval architecture and luxury lifestyle debuts.

At FYI Yachts, we don’t just attend these shows—we navigate them for you. Whether you are looking to commission a new build or find a turnkey brokerage gem, here are the dates you need to bookmark for the upcoming season.

Winter: The Season of Premieres

  • Discover Boating New York Boat Show | Jan 21–25, 2026 Kick off the year at the Javits Center. A staple for Northeast boaters looking to escape the chill and plan their summer escapes.
  • Discover Boating Miami International Boat Show | Feb 11–15, 2026 The centerpiece of the winter season. As a Miami-based firm, this is our playground. Expect a massive display of everything from center consoles to world-class superyachts across the Venetian Causeway and beyond.

Spring: Mediterranean Previews & Atlantic Classics

  • Palm Beach International Boat Show | March 25–29, 2026 The more intimate, luxury-focused alternative to Miami. Perfect for viewing 100ft+ vessels in a sophisticated, walkable setting along Flagler Drive.
  • Dubai International Boat Show | April 8–12, 2026 The gateway to the Middle Eastern market, showcasing the absolute pinnacle of marine technology and opulence.
  • Palma International Boat Show | April 29–May 2, 2026 The Mediterranean season officially wakes up in Mallorca. A key event for those considering a summer charter or purchase in the Balearics.

Fall: The Superyacht Summits

  • Cannes Yachting Festival | Sept 8–13, 2026 Europe’s leading in-water show. There is no better place to see the latest European designs making their world debut.
  • Monaco Yacht Show | Sept 23–26, 2026 The undisputed heavyweight champion of the yachting world. Port Hercule becomes the global epicenter of superyachting, reserved for the largest and most prestigious vessels on the planet.
  • Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show (FLIBS) | Oct 28–Nov 1, 2026 The “Greatest Boat Show on the Seven Seas.” FLIBS remains the most important sales event of the year for the American market.
